mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather, featuring clear skies near the high school and a waning gibbous moon. The temperature will dip to a low of 64 degrees tonight, and we are not expecting any rain.

The city has released information regarding the Verona Cemetery located on North Main Street, where plots are now available for purchase by anyone, regardless of residency. Additionally, residents can now apply for a 30 dollar rain barrel rebate to help with water conservation and stormwater management.

We have plenty going on, starting with yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or the Wisconsin Brewing Company, and look forward to the Farmer's Market downtown this Tuesday.

Regarding the weekly police update, on August 2nd, officers successfully located a 49-year-old man who had fled from them previously, taking him into custody on charges of bail jumping and resisting arrest.
The Culver's flavor of the day is the delightful Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The shop is open until 10 PM tonight, so stop by soon for a treat.
